# Burntide Notebook (burntide.onrender.com)

> Independent information and ordering website for Burntide, an apple-flavored gummy marketed to support healthy weight management in adults. 30 gummies a jar; Supplement Facts: serving 1 gummy (2.5 g), 30 servings, 8 calories, 2 g carbohydrates, 2 g sugars (1 g added), sodium 2.5 mg, calcium 1 mg, magnesium 0.75 mg, proprietary blend 525 mg of apple cider vinegar and BHB (beta-hydroxybutyrate) calcium, magnesium and sodium salts; other ingredients corn syrup, purified water, pure cane sugar, apple pectin, citric acid, sodium citrate, tapioca starch, natural flavors, beet root powder. Directions: one gummy daily about 30 minutes before a morning or afternoon meal with a full glass of water. 6 bottle bundle $49 a bottle ($294, free US shipping, three digital bonus covers); 2 and 3 bottle prices shown at checkout; 60-day money-back guarantee, empty bottles accepted per the seller.

IMPORTANT: Burntide is a supplement, not a real fat burner and not a treatment for obesity or diabetes; no weight-loss result is promised. Not FDA approved (supplements are not). It contains sugar; vinegar and ketone salts may matter with insulin, sulfonylureas and SGLT2 inhibitors; minerals may matter with kidney disease and low-sodium diets. Adults 18+ only; pregnant or nursing people and anyone under a physician's care should consult a physician. Seek care for nausea with deep fast breathing, confusion, severe belly pain or trouble breathing.

Not the maker's website. Contains affiliate links.
